prs.location: Perfectly positioned beside Swords Retail Park and Airside Shopping Centre, Fosterstown Place offers immediate access to shops, cafés, leisure facilities and services. The location is ideal for easy access, particularly Dublin Airport, which is just minutes away, as well as for commuters requiring fast access to the M50 and wider Dublin area.

description:
Fosterstown Place – Contemporary A Rated Apartments in an Exceptionally Connected Location

Fosterstown Place is a high quality residential development offering a superb mix of 1, 2 and 3 Bedroom apartments in the heart of Swords, Dublin 9. Finished to an excellent standard throughout, these spacious and energy efficient homes provide modern living in one of North Dublin’s most convenient and well connected locations.

The apartments are generously proportioned, with bright interiors, impressive views, and a strong emphasis on comfort and quality. The development is beautifully landscaped, creating a calm and attractive residential environment while remaining close to every essential amenity.

These A rated, energy efficient apartments combine excellent design with low running costs, making Fosterstown Place an ideal choice for modern city living.
Parking available at an additional cost.
